dataset_title: Cyclic peptides binding to protein targets

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for one binding measurement record.

fields.name: peptide_sequence
fields.description: The amino acid sequence of a peptide in a single-letter code.

fields.name: peptide_cyclization_type
fields.description: The type of peptide cyclization is head-tail (amide bond between the N and C ends), disulfide (S–S bridge), side-chain (cyclization through side chains), etc.

fields.name: target_type
fields.description: The name of the specific target protein (for example, HER2, EGFR, SARS-CoV-2 Mpro) to which the peptide binds.

fields.name: target_class_sequence
fields.description: The sequence of the target protein. It indicates which amino acids make up the portion of the protein to which the peptide binds.

fields.name: target_class
fields.description: Functional class of target protein: kinase, protease, GPCR, ion channel, receptor, etc.

fields.name: affinity_value
fields.description: The number (12.5, 0.5, 250) is how strongly the peptide binds to the target IC50, Ki, Kd (in nM). The lower the number, the stronger the connection.

fields.name: affinity_unit
fields.description: The unit of affinity value is nM (nanomolar), µM (micromolar), pM (picomolar).
fields.normalization_rule: Map synonyms to nM, μM, pM, M; store original in notes if converted.

fields.name: affinity_type
fields.description: Type of measured affinity IC50 (semi-maximal inhibitory concentration), Ki (inhibition constant), Kd (dissociation constant).

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Identifier linking to an entry in specs/source_map.json.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Category of source (paper, database, web page, etc.).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL or landing page for the source.

fields.name: doi
fields.description: Digital Object Identifier when available.

fields.name: extraction_method
fields.description: The method of extracting data from the source (manual from PDF, spreadsheet, web scraping, API, etc.).

fields.name: extraction_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in extracted values: high, medium, low, or unknown.

fields.name: method
fields.description: The method used to measure the affinity of SPR (surface plasmon resonance), ITC (isothermal titration calorimetry), fluorescence, AlphaScreen.

fields.name: cyclization_positions
fields.description: Positions of amino acids involved in cyclization (numbering from 1). Example: 1-16, Cys3-Cys11, Nterm-Lys7.

fields.name: temperature_C
fields.description: The temperature of the experiment in degrees Celsius.

fields.name: pH
fields.description: The pH value of the buffer solution during measurement.

fields.name: buffer
fields.description: Buffer solution composition: 'PBS, 0.05% Tween20', '50 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl'.

fields.name: mutations
fields.description: Description of mutations in the peptide relative to the natural or initial sequence (for example, 'C3S, K5R' - The 3rd cysteine was replaced by serine, the 5th lysine by arginine, 'Y6F').

fields.name: structure_resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the PDB structure (Å, NMR, EM, null).

fields.name: uniprot_id
fields.description: UniProt accession number of the target protein. Example: P00533 for EGFR, Q15059 for BRD3

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text notes, caveats, or provenance details.
fields.example: Value taken from Table 2; unit inferred from caption.
